directions.source_quote:
The respondents, the concerned Treasury
Officer in particular are, therefore, directed to
pay interest @ 8% per annum on the gratuity
and arrear pension  from the date of retirement
of the petitioner till the date of such payment.
The payment as aforesaid shall be made
within the period of eight weeks from the date of
communication of this order, in default the said
arrear amount shall fetch an additional interest
of 2% per annum.
